findings.summary: When validation errors open the curriculum dialog, the error summary is not focused or reliably announced.
findings.fix: After showModal(), focus the in-dialog error summary when present before returning; otherwise focus the first invalid field. This ensures the error is announced when the modal opens.
findings.evidence: showModal() is followed by an early return when dialog.contains(errorSummary), bypassing the later error-focused field selection.

passed: The overlay is created as a native dialog and opened with showModal(), providing modal semantics and focus containment.
The dialog is labelled by its form heading.
Normal opening moves focus into the form; native dialog closing supports focus return to the opener.
A visible Close button closes the dialog, and Escape closes an open dialog.
